components.name: MetricBadge

components.name: Starfield

components.name: StatusBadge

components.name: StatusCluster
components.description: Read-only status row in the topbar right region. Scrolls horizontally with edge fades when it outgrows the bar.

useWhen: Multiple status pills (mode, spoons, calm, chips)

components.name: Topbar
components.description: Unified app-chrome shell — slot-based three-region layout. Brand / center / statusCluster / mode / trailing / identity, with variant (app|marketing|game) and mobile overrides. The identity slot is auth-agnostic (SignInLink / IdentityChip / AccountMenu fills).

examples: <Topbar brand={<Crown/>} center={<CommandTrigger/>} statusCluster={<StatusCluster><SpoonCluster level={3}/></StatusCluster>} mode={<ModePill mode="spark"/>} trailing={<Avatar/>}/>

components.name: TopbarSection
components.description: Vertically-centered, gap-consistent slot group inside a Topbar. Owns internal spacing; the Topbar owns arrangement.

spacing_rules.component_forbidden_description: Components do not declare external spacing. Only templates do.
spacing_rules.template_allowed_description: Templates control all external spacing. Components control only internal geometry.
spacing_rules.component_allowed_description: These properties control internal appearance only. They do not affect layout positioning.

cascade_layers.description:
Templates always override component styling cleanly without !important specificity wars.
This eliminates the need for !important hacks in Header.astro and other layout components.

reset.description: Normalize CSS, base resets. Lowest priority.

tokens.description: Design tokens (CSS variables). Second lowest priority.

components.description: Component-specific styles. Default priority.

templates.description: Template/layout styles. Higher priority than components.

overrides.description: Highest priority. One-off overrides for specific pages. Use sparingly.

svg_rules.description: All SVGs must fit inside a bounding box defined in bounding_boxes section.

svgo_transform.description: SVGO plugins to run on every SVG import. Automatically trims whitespace, tightens viewBox, and normalizes structure.

viewBox_trimming.description: Automatically recalculate viewBox to the visible bounding box of all paths. Removes descender whitespace.

container_wrapping.description: All SVGs are wrapped in a container that enforces the bounding box dimensions.

agent_prompt_injection.description: This section is injected into Claude, Gemini, and Kilo prompts.

claude.instruction:
When generating React components:
1. Read the bounding_boxes section to know the exact dimensions of icons and SVG containers.
2. NEVER use marginTop, marginBottom, or any forbidden property listed in spacing_rules.component_forbidden_properties.
3. Always wrap SVGs in a container that matches the bounding box dimensions.
4. Use internal styling only (component_allowed_internal_properties).
5. Run your generated code through the SpatialValidator before submission.
6. Use scale tokens (--p31-scale-*) for sizing. Derive everything from --p31-base.
7. Use color.quantum tokens for accents, color.surface for backgrounds, color.text for typography.

gemini.instruction:
When designing page layouts and templates:
1. Use the layout_containers section to define macro-architecture.
2. Define slots with explicit bounding box expectations.
3. Use only template_allowed_properties for external spacing.
4. Understand that components cannot declare margin; spacing is your job.
5. Respect the cascade_layers order — templates override components, not the other way around.
6. Use scale tokens (--p31-scale-*) for spacing. Use spacing tokens (--p31-space-*) for gaps.
7. Use typography.size tokens for font sizes. All are fluid clamp() values.

kilo.instruction:
When executing the build pipeline:
1. Read the svg_rules section and run SVGO normalization on all SVG imports.
2. Validate all components against the spacing_rules section using SpatialValidator.
3. Fail the build if any component violates the rules.
4. Ensure all generated code respects the cascade_layers order.
5. Generate CSS from tokens using the export scripts in cli/tokens/.
6. Run p31 health before deployment.

crown_svg.description: Crown.svg — how it should be configured to fit icon_lg bounding box
crown_svg.notes:
- viewBox is trimmed to visible content (top whitespace removed)
- No margin, marginTop, or transform hacks
- SVG fills its 40×40 container naturally
